documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Discussion And Approval Of Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended Sep 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Uniparts India reported Q1 FY27 revenue from operations of INR 347 crores, up 27% YoY, with EBITDA rising 55% YoY to INR 90 crores and PAT growing 64% YoY to INR 57 crores. Growth was supported by strong performance in the construction equipment segment, which contributed 45% of overall revenue. Management confirmed that restoration of the Ludhiana finishing shop is progressing on schedule and Mexico operations are set for first warehouse deliveries in Q3 FY27. Uniparts ended the quarter with a net cash balance of approximately INR 190 crores and guided for FY27 revenue growth to exceed FY26 growth by a couple of percentage points. Uniparts India reported a consolidated revenue growth of 27% year-on-year, EBITDA growth of 55%, and PAT growth of 64% for Q1 FY27, which was in line with quarterly guidance and outperformed annual guidance.

guidance.claim: Uniparts expects FY27 revenue growth to be a couple of percentage points higher than the growth delivered in FY26.
guidance.quote: our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q2 FY27 performance to be robust and in line with Q1 FY27.
guidance.quote: So Q2 looks very robust, and I think Q2 should be in line with Q1.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of maintaining EBITDA margins of 20% plus over the cycle.
guidance.quote: We are also very confident of maintaining our 20% EBITDA margin over the cycle.

guidance.claim: The Q1 FY27 performance was in line with quarterly guidance and better than annual guidance.
guidance.quote: This performance is in line with the quarter on quarter guidance we had shared but better than the annual guidance we had given, and reflects the quality of execution by the team across a quarter that was not without its challenges.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q1 to be sequentially in line with Q4 performance.
guidance.quote: Therefore, sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4.

guidance.claim: The company expects the second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half.
guidance.quote: And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

guidance.claim: Uniparts expects growth in FY27 to be in line with FY26 growth rates.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Construction equipment demand remains strong supported by infrastructure and technology investments in the US and Europe.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the U.S. and the government-led investments in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Large agricultural equipment conditions remain weak, with CY2026 representing the cyclical trough ahead of an expected recovery in CY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agricultural equipment in India continues to perform well due to government subsidy programs and increasing adoption in mid-to-higher horsepower categories.
demand_outlook.quote: In the small agriculture equipment, India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programs and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Western market small ag unit volumes are showing early signs of recovery after three consecutive years of decline.
demand_outlook.quote: After 3 consecutive years of volume decline, we are beginning to see some recovery in unit volumes and the direction of growth is encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure-led spending is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility in the construction equipment segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the US and government led spending in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agriculture continues to perform well in India supported by subsidies and rising adoption.
demand_outlook.quote: India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programmes and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: In Western markets, small agriculture growth remains measured with big-ticket equipment purchases deferred due to economic uncertainty.
demand_outlook.quote: In Western markets, small ag growth remains more measured. Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases has been tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility, leading to continued deferral of buying decisions.

demand_outlook.claim: After three consecutive years of volume declines in small agriculture, unit volumes are beginning to see some recovery.
demand_outlook.quote: That said, the bottom appears to be behind us; after three consecutive years of volume declines, we are beginning to see some recovery in unit volumes, and the direction of growth is encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Large agriculture conditions remain subdued with leading OEMs indicating CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom and recovery expected in CY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Conditions remain subdued, as has been widely acknowledged across the industry. Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility led to demand skewing in the aftermarket segment as higher prices caused moderate purchasing.
demand_outlook.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

demand_outlook.claim: Construction equipment demand in North America is expected to continue growing in FY27, with the second half stronger than the first.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: The small agriculture segment in North America is poised for around 5% growth in FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: Large tractor industry volumes in North America continue to decline in the mid-to-high teens year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America and particularly, the industry volumes for large tractors continues to track down in the mid-to-high teens year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Europe's small agriculture market is demonstrating early signs of stabilization.
demand_outlook.quote: In Europe, the small agriculture market is showing early signs of stabilization after a prolonged period of softening.

capex_expansion.claim: Uniparts incurred INR 12 crores of capital expenditure during Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: Restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing on schedule without customer supply disruption.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

capex_expansion.claim: The restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule, and I am pleased to report that customer supply has remained uninterrupted throughout.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex plans remain unchanged at 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure for the quarter stood at INR 12 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: capex stands at INR12 crores for the quarter and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA grew 55% YoY to INR 90 crores due to operating leverage and disciplined cost management.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR90 crores, registering strong 55% growth year-on-year and 10% growth sequentially, reflecting healthy operating leverage and disciplined cost management across the business.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of materials for Q1 FY27 stood at 33.3%, largely driven by product mix changes and a INR 1 crore inventory gain.
margins_costs.quote: There has been a small inventory gain that you will see on the face of the financials, and that's roughly about INR1 crore. But the larger cost of materials at 33.3% is due to the product mix change.

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts expects raw material costs to stay in the range of 34% to 37% over business cycles.
margins_costs.quote: I think what we've always maintained is that our material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%, and that's typical of our business.

margins_costs.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts delivered a 24% EBITDA margin in Q4 FY26 and 22% for full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: A brief on the financial position for quarter 4 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Management considers a 20% EBITDA margin to be sustainable across cycles.
margins_costs.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle.

margins_costs.claim: Full year revenue expanded by 21% while EBITDA grew over 55%.
margins_costs.quote: The full year revenue expanded at 21%, while the EBITDA has grown north of 55%.

orders_capacity.claim: Uniparts maintains a trailing 12-month new business order book of over INR 225 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Construction equipment business contributed 45% of total revenue in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Ashutosh, you are right that in Q1 FY27, the business has really seen a good growth in the construction business, which is today 45% of our total revenue.

orders_capacity.claim: Aftermarket business contributed approximately 12% of Q1 FY27 revenue and was flat YoY in absolute terms.
orders_capacity.quote: Finally, our aftermarket business represents approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 of FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing twelve-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore with a healthy pipeline.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing twelve-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore, with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month business wins exceeded INR 225 crores, growing over 12.5% quarter-on-quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: our new business momentum actually has gained meaningful traction with trailing 12-month business wins exceeding INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Order books strengthened sequentially compared to Q3 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Order books strengthened sequentially compared to the quarter 3 FY26, although the pace of recovery varied across geographies and industry segments.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts ended Q1 FY27 with a net cash position of approximately INR 190 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We ended quarter with net cash position of approximately INR190 crores, underlining the strength of our cash generation capabilities and financial discipline.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital stood at 139 days of TTM revenue as of June 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net working capital stands at 139 days of trailing 12 months revenue as of 30th June, reflecting our near-shoring and warehousing-led business model while remaining broadly under control.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash flow generated during Q1 FY27 stood at INR 44 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated INR44 crores of operating cash during the quarter, and our 12-month trailing EPS stands at INR39.97, reflecting sustained improvement in earnings over the past year.

capital_allocation.claim: The net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Management continues to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate the strategic agenda.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet is in excellent health, and we continue to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate our strategic agenda.

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared a special dividend of INR 101 crores in Q3 FY26 and paid total dividends of INR 170 crores in FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores. In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts remains net debt-free with net cash of INR 160 crores as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: The West Asia situation exerted cost and supply chain pressure during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility caused aftermarket customers to temporarily moderate purchases.
risks_headwinds.quote: The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: The large ag industry is expected to decline by mid-teens in CY2026.
risks_headwinds.quote: Large ag in '26 is facing its trough. We expect mid-teens decline in the large ag industry this year.

risks_headwinds.claim: A finishing shop facility in Ludhiana experienced a fire incident toward the end of Q3.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fresh geopolitical escalations in West Asia in March introduced supply chain uncertainty.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

risks_headwinds.claim: The new wage code introduced in November 2025 impacted profitability by INR 3.4 crores.
risks_headwinds.quote: This performance actually accounts for INR3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are scheduled for Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the fabrication vertical to become a meaningful business within 18 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

management_commitments.claim: Uniparts expects growth in FY27 to be in line with its growth rate in FY26.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

management_commitments.claim: Capex plans will remain maintained in the range of 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
management_commitments.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

management_commitments.claim: Rebuilding efforts at the Ludhiana facility are underway to be online by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: Right. So, Sunil, the efforts are underway to rebuild and to be online by the end of the year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
